faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AffProf.

items.q: What happens when a link breaks?
items.a: AffProf detects it automatically and alerts you right away. On Pro, your traffic can be redirected automatically to a fallback link so you do not lose clicks while you are offline.

items.q: What is a short link and why do I need it?
items.a: Instead of sharing a long messy affiliate URL, AffProf gives you a clean link like affprof.com/go/blueyeti or your own branded domain on Pro. Every click is recorded before redirecting so you know where traffic comes from.

items.q: How often are my links checked?
items.a: On the Free plan, links are checked once per day. On Pro, they are checked 4 times per day for faster detection and stronger protection.

items.q: Do I need to change my current affiliate links?
items.a: No. You keep your original affiliate URLs. AffProf wraps them with a short link layer and monitors everything in the background.

items.q: Can I use my own domain for short links?
items.a: Yes. On Pro you can connect your own domain so your links can look like go.yourbrand.com/product.

items.q: What affiliate platforms does AffProf support?
items.a: Any platform, including Amazon Associates, ShareASale, Impact, CJ Affiliate, Rakuten, ClickBank, Hotmart, Eduzz, Monetizze, or any custom affiliate URL.

items.q: Can I import my existing links?
items.a: Yes. On Pro you can upload a CSV file with your existing links and import everything in seconds.

items.q: Is there a free trial for Pro?
items.a: Yes. The Pro plan includes a 14-day free trial, and you do not need a credit card to get started.
